claims.quote: He replaced the newspapers in the file labelled 'Windsor' and retied the brown string.
claims.value: stored in press office file labelled 'Windsor' and tied with brown string

claims.quote: The royal butler showed the palace press liaison in with a hand that did not linger; his face was the house’s ledger—polite, economical, not in the habit of giving more than the day demanded.
claims.value: palace press liaison ('media handler for the household')

claims.quote: The liaison’s fingers found the index card where he kept the names of newsreel men and the number of the provincial office in Reading. "There are a few options," he said. "We ask her publicist for a controlled photograph—two or three frames at most—agree a short caption, and issue a single wire. It gives the papers something that can’t be misread in a gossip column. My worry is the columns: the Daily Mirror and The Times will print what they can, the small gossip sheets will make more than the facts. The newsreels will pick up a neat frame if we hand it to them properly."
claims.value: concerned with Daily Mirror, The Times, gossip columns, and newsreels; favors controlled photograph and single wire

claims.quote: Then you will let me know before anything is given to the press
claims.value: must be informed before anything is given to the press

claims.quote: Ultimately, the Queen. Her Private Secretary would, in practice, clear anything billed as official. Locally I would coordinate; anything material goes up the chain.
claims.value: coordinates locally; material decisions escalated to Private Secretary/Queen for clearance

claims.quote: "I will also have the file of cuttings kept under lock until we decide."
claims.value: file of cuttings to be kept locked until decision

claims.quote: If the Queen prefers not to receive her publicly, the household will make that case.
claims.value: prefers private meeting and resists public introduction

promises.promise: The palace press liaison will call the actress's publicist to propose a controlled photograph and will inquire with Buckingham about an official line.
promises.quote: I will call Miss Cavendish’s publicist and put forward a controlled frame. I will also make an inquiry to Buckingham about whether any formal line should be issued from there.
